name: Newegg marketplace (refurbished/OEM reseller) price page for nvidia-quadro-rtx-8000
notes: Refurbished NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000 48GB, GDDR6 ECC, 672 GB/s, PCIe 3.0 x16 - OEM pull. $2,199.99 after 22% off a $2,824.00 list, free shipping. This is the cheapest 48GB RTX 8000 on the Newegg search page and sits just under the $3,000 matrix cutoff; the rest of the page runs $2,990-$3,250 (new and refurb mix). Beware priced-as-$50-$75 accessories and water blocks in the same search result set. 48GB at 672 GB/s makes this the highest-capacity sub-$3000 card found this pass.
